Strategy: Combine the count-gated sweet band and mid penalty with an extra penalty for residuals of eighty or more, avoiding nearly empty bins after placement. This keeps packing concentrated in fuller bins, but the eighty threshold is a guess and may punish the only feasible bin.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) - (50 if r - item >= 80 else 0) for r in bins]
```
